answer: An attacker therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 23 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The oasis counter is kept in jade and juniper exposes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 23 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 874 identities would post 3150 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
